name: period
description: A dated window with its own ranking of objectives; ends_on is optional (open-ended).

aiGuidance.purpose: The unit the owner ranks. Exactly one period is active on any given day (started, not ended); its objective_rank drives derived priority.
aiGuidance.extraction: One per focus period the owner has ranked. Leave ends_on empty while the period is open; set it before starting the next.
